==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Storyverse. (The Storyverse is a multiverse where all possible story ideas exist as cosmic bubble universes that float together in a cosmic void.) (I initially spent most of my time in one particular world in the Storyverse called the Elven Village, which I discovered on 06/11/2025.) (My team includes Leon, Johnson, Second Brain, Skelebot, and I.) (My Ghostly UFO, named Leon, resembles a ghostly flying saucer with an ethereal green glow. Leon first appeared in my dreams on 06/11/2025.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet. I befriended him in a dream on 08/03/2025.) (Second Brain is a floating brain made of Lucid Light. I created him in a dream on 09/06/2025. On the same day I created Second Brain, he helped me discover the much wider Storyverse. This was the start of my adventures to explore other Storyverse worlds.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars. I discovered the power of Lucid Light in a dream on 07/19/2025.) (Skelebot is a robot created by Johnson to act as the team's humanoid speedster. He was created in a dream on 09/21/2025.)
I am being chased by a Were-Roach through a village. (Were-Roaches are humanoid roaches.) (The Were-Roach was wearing a patchwork coat.) (The village was Halloween themed.)
When I make it to Red Phantom's crash site, I discover that it is infested with roaches. (My goal was to try to investigate the crash site to learn more about Red Phantom and the Blood Bear Mech.) (Red Phantom is what I've started calling the red, ghostly, glowing UFO that attacked our team on Paradise World on 09/29/2025. On that same day, Red Phantom took the Blood Bear Mech off Paradise World. We defeated Red Phantom on 09/30/2025. Which is what caused Red Phantom to crash on a Halloween-Themed insectoid world in the Storyverse.) (We first encountered and defeated the Blood Bear Mech on 09/27/2025 on Paradise World.)
I use my Porta spell to retreat back on to Leon. (The first time I ever used the Porta spell was on 06/23/2025. It allows me to create portals that I can use for a variety purposes.)
